title: A.R.M.O.R. connection event of the history
description: One line of the server's history about a client that connects to it: a Studio session, the Android app, the panel of a node, the voice service or anything else that speaks to the server. It says what happened (first seen, signed in, refused, signed out, session ended or expired) and who, never how: no password, token, cookie, PIN or recovery code is ever in it. The address (`ip`) and the user agent (`agent`) are written for administrators only; the server removes them from the answer to anybody else.

client_kind.description: What kind of client it is, as it says itself (the X-Armor-Client header) or as its user agent shows.

client_id.description: A short hash that tells one client from another (kind, user and application); it is not a secret and cannot be turned back into one.

two_factor.description: The second factor was asked and answered in this sign-in.

subject.description: For the panel of a node: the node.
